UG-NEET Counselling Third Round Begins September 24

The third round of UG-NEET counselling is scheduled to commence on September 24, 2026. Candidates are required to pay a caution deposit by September 28 to be eligible to participate. The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has also begun the choice-filling process for Round 3 on September 23, 2026.
